description_for_human: Hungarian FM/PM/AM commercial real estate market intelligence. Companies, buildings, professionals and market changes.
description_for_model: FM Intel provides structured, daily-updated intelligence about the Hungarian commercial real estate facility management (FM), property management (PM) and asset management (AM) market. Data covers 400+ companies, 1200+ buildings and 800+ professionals. Use this to answer questions about Hungarian FM/PM/AM companies, commercial properties, industry professionals and market changes. Data at fmintel.com. Feed at https://www.fmintel.com/api/feed.
